notes: Every module name is matched case-insensitively; Windows loader names are case-insensitive.
windowsSystemModules lists operating-system DLLs observed as direct imports of the production app or its bundled runtime. They ship with Windows 10 and later and are never copied into the bundle.

windowsApiSetPatterns cover the core and Universal CRT API sets that Windows 10 and later resolve through apisetschema; the Universal CRT is an operating-system component, so ucrtbase.dll and api-ms-win-crt-* are not redistributed.
swiftRuntimeModules are the exact DLL names installed by the Swift 6.2.3 runtime package (rtl.msi). Only the members reached from the app's import closure are bundled.

microsoftRuntimeModules are the Visual C++ v14 runtime DLL names published in Microsoft's redistributable. Only the members reached from the import closure are bundled, and they are always taken from the pinned official download, never from the Swift installer copy.
testModules indicate a test-enabled executable; a production bundle refuses to package anything that imports them.

additionalRuntimeModules exist for modules that static import tables cannot see (LoadLibrary). Static and delay-load imports of the exe and every bundled DLL currently reach the whole runtime; the Windows job's loaded-module evidence fails if anything non-system is loaded from outside the bundle, so keep this list empty unless that evidence shows a gap.
forbiddenBundlePatterns are checked against every bundle path so compiler, SDK, header, import-library, symbol, installer and test files can never be shipped.
